caption: The drawing depicts a handheld fan with a hexagonal-shaped top and a long, narrow handle. The handle is solid black and features a sculpted, ornate shape. The body of the fan is decorated with a three-dimensional, cube-like pattern created by arranging small, colored blocks in a tessellated, geometric design. The cubes display various colors and patterns, including shades of yellow, blue, pink, purple, brown, green, white, and red, with some sides of the cubes showing stripes, polka dots, and floral designs. A thin, stitched-looking border in pink surrounds the six-sided face of the fan. The background is a plain, light beige color. At the bottom of the image, the words "WESTCHESTER COUNTY" appear in uppercase letters on the left, and "MAUD SCHMID" appears in uppercase letters on the right.
title: Fire Screen
